design.purpose: Expand the frozen Chinese real-world corpus from 500 to 1500 pages without adding any host already declared by v1/v2.
design.quotaRule: Exactly 200 new sites x 5 accepted pages = 1,000 pages; no site may exceed 5.
design.selectionUnit: registrable site/domain; one site contributes exactly 5 accepted pages or its missing same-cell quota is filled from the supplement
design.templateRule: Canonical URL and DOM digest must be unique. Cap a normalized template signature at 2 pages per site and 8 pages corpus-wide; enforce after capture rather than replacing failed high-risk sites with news details.
design.pageTypeRule: Every declared seed is a page-type target. Remaining per-site quota is reserved for discovered detail/entity pages. Replace failures only within the same vertical and page type.

existingAnchor.decision: No new quota in this increment; the composed 1500-page corpus already contains Xiaohongshu and this avoids site leakage.

evaluationSplit.rule: 60/60/80 sites; every siteFamily belongs to exactly one split

challengeNegativePlan.distribution: 5 preflight-qualified negatives in each of 20 verticals
challengeNegativePlan.acquisition: Use the visible first-party search/filter UI during live preflight, then freeze its canonical final URL; never invent a path.
challengeNegativePlan.acceptance: HTTP 200, >=80 visible chars, stable complete DOM, explicit no-results/empty-filter/delisted state, no login wall, CAPTCHA, challenge, server error, or hydration failure.
challengeNegativePlan.label: expectedDisposition=exclude; failures remain capture failures and are replaced by a same-vertical/same-split negative from the supplement.
challengeNegativePlan.note: The representative config remains directly runnable. Negative URLs are added only after live UI preflight because search routes and tokens are unstable.

riskLegend.low: Usually public server-rendered HTML; still preflight status, visible text, URL stability and screenshot.
riskLegend.medium: Dynamic rendering, regional variants, paywall snippets or intermittent throttling are plausible.
riskLegend.high: Login/challenge/CAPTCHA, aggressive anti-automation, iframe-only content or expiring URL tokens are expected.
